text.en:
The Wangan Barangay High School in Kalinan, Davao City, is hereby converted into a national
agricultural school to be known as the Wangan National Agricultural School.

The amount of two hundred thousand pesos for the operation of the school shall be charged to
the appropriations authorized by Batas Pambansa Blg. 80 for the Ministry of Education and Culture intended
for new national schools. Thereafter, the necessary sum for its operation and maintenance shall be included in
the annual General Appropriations Act.
Approved: February 8, 1982
